articles.title: S&P gives BlackRock tokenized reserve fund top stability rating
articles.snippet: The rating recognizes the fund’s ability to maintain a stable net asset value, while S&P separately reaffirmed USDT among the lowest-rated stablecoins under its existing assessment framework.

articles.title: This Bitcoin Bridge Shut Itself Down Because AI Was Finding Bugs Too Fast
articles.snippet: Non-custodial Bitcoin swap provider Boltz says attackers are finding vulnerabilities faster than its team can fix them, forcing it to suspend swaps indefinitely.

articles.title: Former FBI Agent Charged With Stealing Nearly $1 Million in Crypto and Using ChatGPT for Investment Advice
articles.snippet: Prosecutors say the former counterintelligence supervisor stole cryptocurrency from wallets tied to FBI investigations before asking ChatGPT how to invest the money and relocate to Europe.

articles.title: What Is an Air-Gapped Bitcoin Wallet? Why the Coldcard Exploit Changes the Conversation About Offline Security
articles.snippet: Air-gapped wallets keep private keys completely offline, reducing exposure to hackers—but they're not immune from threats.
